title: 256GB Mac vs 2 DGX Spark
body:
Question: if your goal is to run inference, have a bunch of docker containers running your software and bunch of users using your product. What’s the most efficient route given both above options cost the same amount roughly.

I’m looking at running Qwen 70b or nemotron 70b model. I need concurrency of calls so it’s not running in queue and want my model to be in the vLLM (maybe mlx for Mac)

What’s the true pros and cons of both platforms ?

submitted by /u/Whyme-__-
summaryZh: 用户对比了256GB内存的Mac与双DGX Spark在运行70B模型时的推理效率和并发处理能力。
